messages:
samira_sales: FYI - Fluxion POC kickoff scheduled next Tue but procurement/legal flagged blockers: 1) they insist no billing without a signed orderform, 2) DPA contains a permissive "legacy vendor chain" clause, 3) they request customer-managed HSM for keys, 4) EU affiliate may require original (wet-ink) MSA. tagging @claire_legal @ben_procure @omar_se @ida_security.

claire_legal: can you paste the DPA snippet? if it's broad transfer language we propose either notice + 30d objection + SCCs or a named-subprocessor appendix. also suggest fallback: eSign orderform for POC only with explicit "POC-only" carveout.

samira_sales: pasted from their counsel:
```
"Vendor may rely on legacy vendor chain partners and is permitted to transfer Customer Data internationally without prior notice unless Customer has expressly withheld consent in writing."
```

claire_legal: can't accept as-is. i'll prepare two short redlines: (A) "Vendor will publish subprocessors, give 30 days' notice of changes and Customer may object; transfers subject to SCCs or equivalent safeguards." (B) "Named-subprocessor appendix; additions require written consent." will drop both later today.

ben_procure: on signed orderform: we can delay environment activation until PO received OR accept pre-paid credits (invoice due on receipt). finance defaults Net30; Net45 requires CRO approval. recommend an overage cap on the orderform (suggest $1500) to avoid billing disputes.

omar_se: tech note: hosted API does NOT support customer-managed HSM. Dedicated/Private support BYO-KMS/HSM. if HSM is non-negotiable for POC, we need to provision Dedicated which adds provisioning lead time (~6-12 business days) and a price uplift (~20-35%). quick alternative: client-side encryption or scoped managed KMS for POC but procurement often pushes back.

ida_security: ask them to complete our security questionnaire and provide SOC2 report. if the EU affiliate claims they must have wet-ink, ask them to share the internal policy excerpt. many EU subsidiaries accept eSign + audit trail. questionnaire: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qa

samira_sales: thanks. asks: Claire 1 drop redlines in-thread; Omar 1 confirm exact provisioning ETA + cost delta for Dedicated w/ HSM; Ben/Finance 1 confirm pre-bill vs PO and if $1500 cap is acceptable. I'll also ask Fluxion for the EU policy excerpt and billing contact.

claire_legal: will paste both redline options in this thread by 17:30 CET. adding fallback language: "Orderform executed electronically authorizes POC activation only; final MSA (electronic or original) governs production."

ben_procure: finance_ops: flagged - Net45 needs commercial signoff. pre-bill (Net0) ok to unblock. can accept $1500 overage cap; if Fluxion wants higher, need justification. need billing contact to issue PO or accept invoice.

omar_se: confirmed: Dedicated provisioning estimate 6-12 business days. HSM setup must be applied during provisioning. cost uplift estimate +25% for typical pilot config; if they accept smaller instance we can fast-track to ~4 days with lower uplift.

docusign-bot: Created envelope ENV-20488 for Fluxion POC orderform (expires in 14 days). Signers: Fluxion PO, samira_sales. Status: pending.

ida_security: also note: if they require EU-only residency + HSM, include residency clause on the orderform so we provision in-region.

samira_sales: I'll propose flow to customer: 1) eSign orderform with pre-billed credits or PO + $1500 overage cap to start hosted POC now; 2) fluxion completes sec questionnaire + provides SOC2; 3) if HSM is required we pause hosted and provision Dedicated (new orderform, lead time/cost noted); 4) if EU affiliate requires original MSA we accept wet-ink for final MSA but request eSign for orderform to avoid blocking kickoff. sharing Claire's redlines + questionnaire now. will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
